title: Zoo Friends ABC
hook: Wild animals stay wild, even behind a viewing window.
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
responseSpace: one beat with animal sounds reduced
visualStyle: friendly 3D zoo storybook, colorful habitats, non-scary animals, bold silhouettes, simple backgrounds

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: a child observing zoo animals respectfully
creativeFingerprint.round2Grammar: observation cue -> recall beat -> target -> point/shape gesture
creativeFingerprint.sectionContrast: Round 1 paints clues; chorus opens wide; Round 2 strips back for recall. Signature: a warm marimba footprint and soft hand-drum answer after the target.
creativeFingerprint.signatureColor: a warm marimba footprint and soft hand-drum answer after the target
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Make Zoo Friends ABC a behavior-observation walk: feeding, resting, social grouping, climbing, swimming and thermoregulation are observed through habitat design without treating wild animals as pet-like friends.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: A child reads exhibit signs, watches behavior at distance, and accepts that a resting or hidden animal does not owe a performance.
